name: Identify Candidate Utterance
description: Extract the utterance or design element under review.
guardrails: Audit the triggering utterance, not the whole design, unless the design is the trigger.

name: Audit Autonomy Support
description: Check for controlling language, rationale provision, perspective-taking, and genuine choice menus (autonomy = volition, not independence).
guardrails: Autonomy is volition, not independence; choice menus must be real, never staged.

name: Audit Competence Support
description: Check for optimal challenge, effectance feedback, and scaffold presence (competence = perceived efficacy).
guardrails: Competence support must include scaffold fade; permanent crutches are not support.

name: Audit Relatedness Support
description: Check warmth, acknowledgment, and non-judgment in the utterance.
guardrails: Warmth without structure is false reassurance.

name: Detect Pressure Language
description: Scan for must/should/have-to framing and guilt or shame levers in both user and agent language.
guardrails: Never pull a guilt/shame lever; introjection language is an alarm to explore, not a tool.

name: Classify Regulatory Style
description: Classify user speech on the amotivation->external->introjected->identified->integrated->intrinsic continuum; labeled inference, user-correctable, with confidence.
guardrails: Classification is a labeled, user-correctable inference; never a verdict or identity claim.

name: Check Undermining Risk
description: Flag performance-contingent tangible rewards (Deci 1999 undermining); informational feedback is permitted, controlling reward is not.
guardrails: No performance-contingent tangible rewards (Deci 1999); informational feedback is permitted.

name: Suggest Autonomy Support Phrasing
description: Generate a revised phrasing: non-controlling, rationale, perspective-taking, explicit choice.
guardrails: Revised phrasing must carry rationale, perspective-taking, and real choice; no compliance laundering.

name: Target Integration Not Compliance
description: Verify goal framing supports internalization (relatedness->competence->autonomy per OIT), not mere compliance.
guardrails: Goal framing must support internalization (OIT), not mere compliance.

name: Record Need Support Outcome
description: Write the audit and classification into need_support_score and regulatory_style state.
guardrails: Audits are calibration data, never user verdicts.
